correctness.rationale: Companion matrix A is cyclic on e1, so sequence period equals matrix order. Mod p the nonscalar repeated-root A=alpha I+J yields ord(A)=m p. B=A^m−I has B nonzero, B²=0 mod p; (I+B)^p=I+pB mod p² since p>=5 gives B^p=0 mod p². This forces exact first and higher lifts by binomial induction. Under Y=X−1, any monic factorization of X^p−1 with both degrees >=2 has linear coefficient divisible by p², whereas target has coefficient p. The p=3 cyclotomic factor is an explicit exception. Independent modular companion powers checked 108 cases p=5,7,11,13 for k=1..3; finite checks are not proof.
residual_risks: Bounded finite verification alone cannot prove the universal claim; symbolic proof reconstruction is the principal support.
